claims.proposition: The verifier MUST recompute the resolved policy snapshot hash before each acceptance transition.

requirement.acceptance_criterion: A transition fixture that skips recomputation is refused.
requirement.rationale: Recomputation prevents acceptance under a snapshot that no longer resolves.

semantic_basis.rationale: The source proposal states the recomputation requirement verbatim.
The authoritative source directly states the recomputation obligation.

claims.proposition: The verifier MUST record the policy snapshot hash under which the receipt was evaluated.

requirement.object: the policy snapshot hash under which the receipt was evaluated
requirement.acceptance_criterion: Every emitted receipt carries the evaluated-under snapshot hash.
requirement.rationale: A receipt binds only to the policy that evaluated it.

semantic_basis.rationale: Follows mechanically from REQ-SHARD-001 plus the receipt schema, which already carries a policy_snapshot_id field.
The value follows mechanically from the recomputation requirement and the existing receipt structure.

claims.proposition: The verifier caches resolved snapshots across acceptance transitions within a single session.

semantic_basis.rationale: Reasonable reading of the source's performance language, but the source does not establish caching uniquely or normatively.

claims.proposition: The intended latency budget for snapshot recomputation cannot be established from the source or from author intent.

semantic_basis.rationale: The source states no budget and the authoring process recorded no intent; the value is left unresolved rather than invented.

claims.proposition: The verifier MUST treat shard-boundary drift as a policy change that requires a new snapshot resolution.

requirement.object: shard-boundary drift as a policy change requiring a new snapshot resolution
requirement.acceptance_criterion: A drift fixture triggers a fresh resolution before the next acceptance transition.
requirement.rationale: Boundary drift changes which rules apply; the source is silent, so this is a new authoring decision.

semantic_basis.rationale: Introduced under the ATS authoring authority as a new design choice; the source does not address drift.
New judgment added by the authoring process, distinct from extracting source truth.

evidence.proposition: The policy-shard verification proposal states recomputation and recording obligations for acceptance transitions.

semantic_basis.rationale: The recording obligation follows mechanically from the recomputation obligation and the receipt schema.

glossary.definition: The SHA-256 digest of the currently resolved policy snapshot used to evaluate an acceptance transition.
